name: smithy
description: The smithy: repo-agnostic Claude Code plugins for engineering (forge), product scaffolding (foundry), writing (draft), and Nix environments (anvil).

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Core engineering workflow: execute dev tasks, review diffs, ship draft PRs, cut releases, and generate MCP test harnesses.

plugins.name: foundry
plugins.description: Product factory: scaffold Clean Architecture project templates and deploy them with OpenTofu. Requires forge.

plugins.name: draft
plugins.description: Writing studio: books, poetry, and technical articles, compiled into publishable ebooks. Requires forge.

plugins.name: anvil
plugins.description: Nix environments: shell gates across dialects, distro-family portability audits, devenv environments, and confirmed machine activation. Requires forge.
